title: Scientists Name a Giant Fungus “D-rex”
paragraphs: Scientists found a new fungus in China. They call it D-rex.
It grows in the forests of Yunnan. It grows on old wood and tree roots. It can be 50 centimetres tall.
It is very big for its group. It can weigh 2.2 kilograms. Scientists say its family is very old.

questions.a: In the forests of Yunnan, China.
